title: Bring Sally Up (squat challenge)
creator: Community challenge (Moby, "Flower")
description: Play Moby's "Flower" and squat to the lyrics: sink to the bottom on "bring Sally down", stand on "bring Sally up", and hold the bottom position through every pause in the song. About 30 squats in roughly 3:30, but the holds are what get you. Works with push-ups, pull-ups or a barbell too; the song is the timer.
